title: Design Contact Form UI on Home Page
description: Create a responsive, accessible contact form on the landing page using Shadcn UI components and Tailwind CSS.
details: Add a contact form section to the home page (`/`). Use Shadcn UI components for form fields (name, email, message) and Tailwind CSS for layout and styling. Ensure the form is visually consistent with the rest of the landing page, keyboard-navigable, and meets WCAG AA accessibility standards. Include proper ARIA labels and error states for invalid input.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the form on desktop and mobile. Use keyboard navigation to tab through fields. Run an accessibility audit (e.g., axe-core) to verify ARIA labels and contrast. Check that error states are displayed for invalid input.

title: Implement Form Validation and Submission Handler
description: Add client-side validation and a submission handler for the contact form, ensuring safe and user-friendly input processing.
details: Implement validation for required fields (name, email, message) and proper email format. On submit, prevent default, validate inputs, and display inline error messages if invalid. For now, simulate form submission (e.g., with a success toast or message) since backend/email integration is out-of-scope. Ensure no sensitive data is logged. Optionally, disable the submit button while submitting.
test_strategy: Attempt to submit the form with missing or invalid fields and verify error messages appear. Submit with valid data and confirm the success message displays. Check that the submit button disables during submission and re-enables after.

title: Integrate Contact Form into Home Page Layout
description: Position the contact form within the home page, ensuring it fits the overall design and does not disrupt existing content.
details: Insert the contact form component into the landing page (`/`). Adjust layout and spacing as needed to maintain a clean, responsive design. Ensure the form is discoverable and visually appealing, with clear call-to-action labeling. Update any navigation or anchor links if necessary.
test_strategy: Load the home page and verify the contact form is present, well-positioned, and does not overlap or break existing content. Test responsiveness on various screen sizes.

title: Write Unit and Integration Tests for Contact Form
description: Create automated tests to verify the contact form’s validation, accessibility, and submission logic.
details: Using the project's preferred testing framework (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library), write tests to cover: rendering of all form fields, validation error display, successful submission flow, accessibility attributes, and keyboard navigation. Mock the submission handler to avoid real network calls.
test_strategy: Run all tests and ensure 100% pass rate. Review coverage report to confirm all form logic and edge cases are tested. Address any accessibility violations flagged by automated tools.
